    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {

    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = legendary_shrine }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = legendary_shrine
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = legendary_shrine
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = legendary_palace }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = legendary_palace
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = legendary_palace
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_hall_of_heroes_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {

                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }

                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hall_of_heroes_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hall_of_heroes_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hall_of_heroes_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hall_of_heroes_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hall_of_heroes_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hall_of_heroes_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hall_of_heroes_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hall_of_heroes_04 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hall_of_heroes_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hall_of_heroes_04
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hall_of_heroes_05 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = hall_of_heroes_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = hall_of_heroes_05
                }
            }
        }
    }

                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = generic_gold_mines_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = generic_gold_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = generic_gold_mines_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = generic_gold_mines_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = generic_gold_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = generic_gold_mines_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = generic_gold_mines_04 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = generic_gold_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = generic_gold_mines_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = temple_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = church_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = temple_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = temple_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_temple_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = temple_04 } remove_building = temple_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_03 } remove_building = temple_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_02 } remove_building = temple_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = temple_01 } remove_building = temple_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_tribe_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = tribe_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = tribal_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = tribe_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = tribe_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = tribe_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = tribe_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = tribe_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = tribe_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = tribe_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = tribe_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_tribe_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = tribe_04 } remove_building = tribe_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = tribe_03 } remove_building = tribe_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = tribe_02 } remove_building = tribe_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = tribe_01 } remove_building = tribe_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_academy_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = academy_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = academy_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = academy_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = academy_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = academy_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = academy_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = academy_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = academy_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = academy_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = academy_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_academy_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = academy_04 } remove_building = academy_04 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = academy_03 } remove_building = academy_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = academy_02 } remove_building = academy_02 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = academy_01 } remove_building = academy_01 }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_building_hist_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    is_valid = {
        OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building_or_higher = hist_01 }
                    }
                    set_holding_type = hist_holding
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = hist_01 }
                    }
                    add_building = hist_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hist_02 }
                    }
                    add_building = hist_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hist_03 }
                    }
                    add_building = hist_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hist_04 }
                    }
                    add_building = hist_04
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 5 }
                        NOT = { has_building = hist_05 }
                    }
                    add_building = hist_05
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_tm_destroy_building_hist_sgui = {
    scope = character # Player Character

    effect = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = { limit = { has_building = hist_05 } remove_building = hist_05 }

                else_if = { limit = { has_building = hist_03 } remove_building = hist_03 }
                else_if = { limit = { has_building = hist_02 } remove_building = hist_02 }

            NOT = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level }
            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = sentinel_palace_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = sentinel_palace_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = sentinel_palace_01
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

            var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4
        }
    }

    effect = {
        save_scope_as = player

        every_in_list = {
            variable = DI_action_provinces
            save_scope_as = province

            scope:province = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            NOT = { scope:player = { has_variable = DI_title_manager_building_level } }
                            scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 1 }
                        }
                        NOT = { has_building = karanesh_sulfur_mines_01 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = karanesh_sulfur_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = karanesh_sulfur_mines_01
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 2 }
                        NOT = { has_building = karanesh_sulfur_mines_02 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = karanesh_sulfur_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = karanesh_sulfur_mines_02
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 3 }
                        NOT = { has_building = karanesh_sulfur_mines_03 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = karanesh_sulfur_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = karanesh_sulfur_mines_03
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:player = { var:DI_title_manager_building_level = 4 }
                        NOT = { has_building = karanesh_sulfur_mines_04 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_special_building_slot = no }
                        add_special_building_slot = karanesh_sulfur_mines_01
                    }
                    DI_clear_special_building_effect = yes
                    add_special_building = karanesh_sulfur_mines_04
                }
            }
        }
    }
